title: Match-server assignment
description: The one line of JSON a match server reads on its standard input when it starts (ADR-007 §5). The backend writes it (Backend/internal/match/assignment.go) and VeyraServices binds it to FVeyraAssignmentDocument. It uses the tuning dialect (Game/Tuning/README.md) but is not tuning, and is not part of the tuning hash.

matchId.description: The match's ID, a lowercase UUID. The server reports under it.

backendUrl.description: The backend's base URL as the match server reaches it: http or https, a host, an optional port, no path.

serverCredential.description: The match-server credential (ADR-007 §2): vms_ and the base64url form of 32 bytes. Kept in memory only and never logged.

participants.description: The roster: who may join, and on which side. Each side's size is checked against Match.json teams.maxTeamSize when the server takes the assignment.

accountId.description: The participant's account ID, a lowercase UUID.

displayName.description: The name other players see. Any text without control characters.

side.description: Team A or Team B (Battleground Bible §15).

ticketHash.description: The lowercase hex SHA-256 of the participant's join ticket (ADR-007 §3). The server never receives the ticket itself.
